scope: Supply complete authenticated original timestamp and escaping helper excerpts to every v3 review stage, preserving historical requests, evidence IDs and execution/acceptance restrictions.
riskAnalysis: Additional source context is untrusted data for model review, not authority. Derive only exact bounded helper definitions from the already authenticated task preimage; retain no-tools and no-execution boundaries. Complete excerpts do not prove patch semantics or customer impact.

threatModel.assets: Approved source preimage, immutable prior receipts, original evidence IDs, model request ceilings and authority separation.
threatModel.trustBoundaries: Authenticated source snapshot versus caller-controlled or generated content; source inspection versus code execution; automated criticism versus independent acceptance.
threatModel.abuseCases: Replace helper text with prompt injection, forge source hashes/lines, treat helper names as authorized evidence IDs, overflow request sizing, or claim dynamic tests and acceptance from static excerpts.
threatModel.mitigations: Exact registered v3-only gate; unique fixed source anchors,2048byte bounds, exact source/excerpt hashes and line provenance; explicit evidence-ID qualification; existing schemas/authority/byte/token checks and original request goldens remain.

defects.rootCause: Original review evidence included only recordTime numeric-conversion line and omitted its fallback and esc, leaving genuine invalid-date and escaping questions unanswerable from supplied excerpts.
defects.detectionGap: Prior all-role grammar and receipt checks did not assert complete helper definitions; scope-correct patch application alone cannot establish date semantics.
defects.regression: Actual offline five-stage controller asserts complete exact-source helper body/hash/line in every role, unchanged historical v1/v2 frames, bounded wire size and negative count/prose cleanup. Work separately characterized seven original-helper cases without executing generated source.
defects.historicalPrevention: Review the full dependency closure needed to judge a bounded patch, distinguish inspectable source from dynamic verification, and preserve conditional acceptance when input semantics remain unresolved.

rollback: Keep paid execution disabled and existing grants revoked. Revert helper-context behavior only in a reviewed feature successor; never delete prior receipts, modify historical assets or revive old task approvals.
